designToolRouterReason: E10 C02 adds a pure revision history projection packet and derived history projection support only. It changes no product UI screen, visual composition, renderer surface, Design OS manifest, typography, layout, storage adapter, network adapter, or project truth.

productPlane.dataAuthority: Existing Product Core and manuscript truth remain authoritative. E10 C02 derives history entries only from append-only collab event log entries, Command Kernel receipt references, review apply outcome references, and hash-only author truth refs.
productPlane.writePath: No write path. No Command Kernel dispatch is introduced by this contour.
productPlane.readPath: buildRevisionHistoryProjectionPacket creates a pathless read packet; deriveHistory consumes that packet as params and publishes derived.history.v1 entries.
productPlane.portsAndAdapters: No runtime adapter, storage adapter, network adapter, account adapter, CRDT adapter, or renderer adapter is introduced.

interfacePlane.notes: Existing history surfaces may consume derived.history.v1 entries later; this contour does not alter renderer UI.

acceptanceProof.authorTruthSeparation: author truth snapshots are represented by hash refs with valueIncluded=false; packet entries do not copy author truth values
